naming_policy: Comparison recipes are named by GitHub owner/repo with the commit measured. Model checkpoints are named by Hugging Face repository and revision; the compared checkpoints were only loaded for these measurements, not built on or redistributed.

page_text_facts.earlier_page_text: the decode benchmark shipped in MiaAI-Lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-2x-DGX-Sparks, run unmodified
page_text_facts.fact: the sparkDash cells come from a lab reproduction in Python of the "Decode benchmark" protocol of the MiaAI-Lab/sparkDash repository (server/collectors/DecodeBench.js with its streaming and prompt modules, main branch of 2026-09-18): the same prompt texts, temperature 0, 400 tokens with min_tokens 400, thinking off in the request, one 32-token warm-up stream; not the kit's own script run unmodified

page_text_facts.earlier_page_text: at most 4 (MiaAI-Lab, MAX_NUM_SEQS=4) or 6 (tonyd2wild, --max-num-seqs 6) concurrent requests, as configured by their authors
page_text_facts.fact: admission limits as measured: tp2-miaai-71962cd-long-coding 2, tp2-miaai-7cded8e 4, tp2-tonyd2wild-9fea48c 6, tp4-miaai-7cded8e 4, tp4-tonyd2wild-2ac4e8dd 6; tonyd2wild's TP4 6 slots at 262,144 context were the lab's choice (the published launch: 64 at 500,000); the MiaAI-Lab long-coding example admits 2

page_text_facts.earlier_page_text: a newcomer request arrives while L incumbent streams are running
page_text_facts.fact: prefill-first: one 32,768-token request starts alone and L-1 short requests arrive during its prefill; the cell is the short newcomers' median TTFT. decode-first: L-1 short streams are decoding when one 32,768-token request arrives; the cell is that request's TTFT (RigMark PROTOCOL.md, staggered arrivals; the receipts hold 1 incumbent and L-1 newcomers in prefill-first, L-1 incumbents and one 32,768-token newcomer in decode-first)

data_check.statistic: the median of each RigMark distribution; for sparkDash the median over the rounds of each cell's mean stream decode rate
